description: This file defines the ResolvedTargetData class used for computing and caching target-specific dependency and linkage information in a build system, including methods for retrieving dependencies, libraries, frameworks, and related data for build targets.

classes.name: ResolvedTargetData
classes.description: A class for computing and caching target dependency and linkage data, providing methods to retrieve dependencies, libraries, frameworks, and other target-related information.

methods.name: GetTargetDeps
methods.description: Returns the dependencies of a target as a ResolvedTargetDeps instance.

methods.name: GetDataDeps
methods.description: Returns data dependencies of a target as a span of Target pointers.

methods.name: GetLinkedDeps
methods.description: Returns linked dependencies of a target as a span of Target pointers.

methods.name: GetLinkedLibraryDirs
methods.description: Returns library directory search paths for a target.

methods.name: GetLinkedLibraries
methods.description: Returns library files to link for a target.

methods.name: GetLinkedFrameworkDirs
methods.description: Returns framework directory search paths for macOS/iOS targets.

methods.name: GetLinkedFrameworks
methods.description: Returns framework names for macOS/iOS targets.

methods.name: GetLinkedWeakFrameworks
methods.description: Returns weak framework names for macOS/iOS targets.

methods.name: GetLinkedWeakLibraries
methods.description: Returns weak library files for macOS/iOS targets.

methods.name: GetHardDeps
methods.description: Returns a set of hard dependencies for the target.

methods.name: GetInheritedLibraries
methods.description: Returns an ordered list of inherited link-time libraries.

methods.name: GetModuleDepsInformation
methods.description: Returns an ordered list of module dependencies.

methods.name: GetSwiftModuleDependencies
methods.description: Returns Swift module dependencies for the target.
